decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of six months from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for prayer hall. and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1      of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for D1 use purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times _9am to 9pm Monday to Sunday_.
Condition : 5 - The use shall be carried on only by the Trustees of the Shree Jalaram Seva Trust.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side or rear walls of the buildings hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Within three months of the date of this permission, details of sound insulation measures for the building shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and the details so approved shall be implemented within three months of the date on which they are approved
Condition : 8 - Three parking spaces shall be kept permanently available at the site for use by visitors and staff of the prayer hall.
Condition : 9 - The hall and side doors to the building (including the extension and portable building) shall remain closed at all times when the building is in use.
Condition : 10 - No system for the amplification of sound or speech shall be used either within the building or external to the building.

Condition : 11 - No activity shall be carried out outside the existing buildings on the site without the prior written approval of the local planning authority.  Should the applicant wish to carry out activity outside these buildings on certain festival days or for other activities, the application for council permission shall include any means to mitigate against potential harm to residents through the activities of worshippers, including traffic management and parking control measures.
Condition : 12 - An efficient and effective extraction system shall be maintained at all times to deal with cooking odours so that no odour is detectable outside the premises boundary.
Condition : 13 - No deliveries or collections, including refuse collection, shall take place between 9.00 pm and 07.00 am on any day and not at all on Sundays or public holidays.
Condition : 14 - The fire exit door from the kitchen shall remain shut except in cases of emergency
description: Request for the removal of Condition 1 for the continuous use of a detached outbuilding as a prayer house, as approved under application  P/2005/3389 dated 14/09/2006.
